queries.english: Who has a hand on the dark box that starts out on the pink storage bin?
queries.chinese: 此刻用手接触这个黑色包装盒的人。

queries.english: Who has touched the dark box that starts out on the pink storage bin at any point so far?
queries.chinese: 从视频开头到现在，曾用手接触过这个黑色包装盒的人；松手后仍算。

queries.english: Who was the most recent person to start touching the dark box that starts out on the pink storage bin?
queries.chinese: 按第一次清楚看见每次接触的先后，选最近开始接触这个黑盒的人；不按谁最后松手判断。

queries.english: Who was the first person in this video to touch the dark box that starts out on the pink storage bin?
queries.chinese: 从视频开始到现在，最早开始用手接触这个黑盒的人。

queries.english: Who has touched the dark box that starts out on the pink storage bin but is not touching it now?
queries.chinese: 此前碰过这个黑盒、但此刻没有碰它的人。

events.title: 两人先后接触黑色包装盒
events.criterion: 手直接接触视频开头放在粉色收纳箱上的黑色包装盒即开始；手完全离开这个盒子时结束。接触旁边橙色盒子或黄色长盒不算。拿起后继续握着同一个黑盒仍算。只选接触者，不选盒子。
